purpose: Objective conformance scoring for Coding Agent runs of the frozen interoperability task (v0.9 plan section 13.3). Artistic taste is recorded as a human note and never changes the conformance score.

categories.evidence: clean install/build/run of the generated consumer from a fresh checkout
import of the manifest-declared frame function plus the runtime probe passing
dependency list and source inspection find no audio decoding, FFT, or beat detection
browser pause/seek/replay probes or offline frame probes pass
canonical checkpoint hashes match the shared fixture
diagnostics show scene-scale state changing at structural boundaries
automated state inspection with reduced motion enabled
no BeatScope player code fingerprint in the generated source

human_notes.role: Artistic taste, documentation quality, and visual polish are recorded as free-text human notes.
